data.one_liner: Flutter plugin enabling passkey authentication based on WebAuthn and FIDO2.
data.what_it_does: Enables user registration and login through native device biometrics (such as Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint readers) using passkeys. Abstracts platform-specific passkey APIs on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web. Supports advanced features like the PRF extension and conditional UI creation.
use_when: You want to implement passkey-based signup and login in your Flutter application
You are using a custom relying party server or a provider like Corbado that implements WebAuthn
You need to derive secrets from a passkey using the WebAuthn PRF extension
avoid_when: You only require traditional password or standard OAuth/social login flows without passkeys
You are targeting platforms that do not support passkeys like Linux
strengths: Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web
Supports WebAuthn PRF extension for client-side encryption key derivation
Handles platform-specific complexities of WebAuthn and conditional UI
weaknesses: Requires a compatible relying party backend to store and validate public keys
Platform support varies for certain features (e.g., conditional create or PRF require specific OS versions)
data.setup_notes: Requires proper association configuration with your relying party server and native app identifiers for passkey functionality to work.

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic device biometric prompting (fingerprint/face) rather than standard WebAuthn passkey authentication.
